# docker_container_stats (Data Source)

Reads one resource usage sample of a container (CPU, memory, network, block I/O, PIDs), like `docker container stats --no-stream`. The sample is taken at read time and changes on every plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_container_stats" "db" {
  container = "db"
}

output "db_memory_usage_bytes" {
  value = data.docker_container_stats.db.stats.memory_stats.usage
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container` (String) The container to read, by ID or name.

### Optional

- `include_previous_sample` (Boolean) Let the daemon take a second sample one second earlier so `precpu_stats` is filled and CPU percentages can be computed (Engine `one-shot=false`). Default `false`: one immediate sample.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of stats_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `id` (String) Container ID.
- `name` (String) Container name, without the leading `/`.
- `stats` (Attributes) The GET /containers/{id}/stats?stream=false response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stats))
- `stats_json` (String) The exact Engine API GET /containers/{id}/stats?stream=false response as JSON.
